items.name: Coral Shell Crown
items.description: Three scallop shells on a band. Very royal, slightly damp.

items.name: Lilac Shell Crown
items.description: Lilac scallops. Lectures feel calmer down here.

items.name: Gold Shell Crown
items.description: Gold-tipped shells for the top of the class.

items.name: Starfish Sticker
items.description: A starfish on one cheek. Holds on like it means it.

items.name: Pink Starfish
items.description: A pink starfish, stuck on for the whole exam period.

items.name: Violet Starfish
items.description: Violet, and it never misses a deadline.

items.name: Shell Necklace
items.description: Pink shells on a brown cord. Clicks when you walk.

items.name: Cream Shell Necklace
items.description: Cream shells on a gold cord. Sounds like the sea.

items.name: Lilac Shell Necklace
items.description: Lilac shells on a navy cord, for long sessions by the sea.

items.name: Kelp Scarf
items.description: Long green kelp, wrapped twice round your neck.

items.name: Teal Kelp Scarf
items.description: Teal fronds, warm enough for the cold lecture hall.

items.name: Sun-Bleached Kelp Scarf
items.description: Brown and gold, bleached by a summer at sea.

items.name: Seashell
items.description: Hold it to your ear. The sea says start early.

items.name: Cream Seashell
items.description: Cream and gold, with a very calm hum.

items.name: Blue Seashell
items.description: Blue shell, cool head, steady breathing.

items.name: Message in a Bottle
items.description: A note inside: the answer is in chapter three.

items.name: Blue Message Bottle
items.description: Same note, bluer glass. Still chapter three.

items.name: Amber Message Bottle
items.description: Same note, warmer glass. Still chapter three.

items.name: Sponge Cap
items.description: Soaks up everything you read. Squeeze gently.

items.name: Pink Sponge Cap
items.description: Soft and pink, a little holey, very absorbent.

items.name: Fishbowl Hat
items.description: A bowl on your head, with a fish who knows the answers.

items.name: Green Fishbowl Hat
items.description: Green glass and a yellow fish. Keeps you company.

items.name: Pearl Drop
items.description: A single pearl on the cheek. Dramatic, but polished.

items.name: Blue Pearl Drop
items.description: A blue pearl, for when a grade surprised you.

items.name: Captain's Coat
items.description: White buttons, a proud collar, ready for the long semester.

items.name: Brick Captain's Coat
items.description: Rust-red and very sure of its course.

items.name: Crab Friend
items.description: A little crab that pinches procrastination.

items.name: Teal Crab Friend
items.description: Teal, sideways thinking, and it walks at its own pace.

items.name: Conch Shell
items.description: Listen closely. Somewhere a lecture is echoing.

items.name: Golden Conch
items.description: Gold-rimmed and very shiny. Loud, for a shell.

items.name: Brass Diving Helmet
items.description: An open-face brass helmet. Bubbles rise when you go deep.

items.name: Seahorse Clip
items.description: A seahorse clip that bobs along with your thoughts.

items.name: School of Fish
items.description: Four fish, always on their way somewhere else.

items.name: Pearl in a Clam
items.description: A clam open just enough to show its pearl.

items.name: Sea Staff
items.description: Three tines and one gem. Strictly for ceremonies.

items.name: Turtle Shell Pack
items.description: Carries its home on its back, and the notes too.

items.name: Sea-Glass Float
items.description: A glass float on a rope. Bobs when you are thinking.

items.name: Anglerfish Lure
items.description: A glowing lure on your headband. Lights up dark topics.

items.name: Sea Lantern
items.description: A brass cage with a soft light that breathes with you.

items.name: Kelp Sway
items.description: Kelp that sways beside you, slow and steady.

items.name: Little Whale
items.description: A tiny whale circles you and blows bubbles of encouragement.
